Beacon is a modular, client-side utility mod for Minecraft 26.2 built for Fabric, providing a broad collection of quality-of-life, rendering, world, utility, and fun features in a single lightweight client modification.

Beacon is designed around a strict vanilla-server-safe approach. The project intentionally excludes combat automation, movement automation, ESP and wallhack functionality, and server exploits. Its focus is instead on improving the everyday Minecraft client experience through configurable utilities, visual enhancements, quality-of-life improvements, and additional client-side functionality.

The mod includes features across five main categories: Render, World, Utility, Fun, and Misc. It also provides a modular architecture with configuration persistence, keybind support, the `/beacon` command, an addon API, and support for enabling and configuring modules through the Beacon configuration system.

Beacon is intended for developers and players who want an extensible client-side utility mod for Minecraft 26.2, with an emphasis on maintainability, configurable features, and compatibility with vanilla servers. The project includes dedicated verification and development tooling for areas such as the user interface, configuration handling, and Freecam functionality.

Beacon is open source and distributed under the GNU General Public License v3 for the combined work, with additional attribution and licensing information provided for original and third-party components.
